messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy aborted for canary rollout 2026.03.18-7 due to image push error to ECR.
ci-bot: build/4278 failed at push step: 'Tag already exists with different manifest'.
Alex P: ugh, looks like a tagging race. two parallel pipelines pushed same tag `release-latest` with different images.
Maya R: confirm — build 4278 and 4279 both attempted `release-latest` at ~14:02 UTC.
Samir: logs show `denied: manifest with digest exists and differs` from aws-ecr plugin.
Nina: can we just rollback the canary?
OpsOnCall: yes please rollback. marking change window blocked for 30m. :no_entry:
Alex P: rolling back to `release-2026-03-17-3` on the cluster now.
deploy-bot: Rollback triggered by Alex P (manual) — rollout rollback in progress.
Maya R: quick mitigation idea: pin CI to push unique tag per build (e.g., `release-${GIT_COMMIT:0:8}-${BUILD_ID}`) and only update `release-latest` in a single atomic step after successful push.
Samir: agree. short term we should also prefer image digests when deploying: `image: 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/service@sha256:<digest>`
Nina: can we patch the current pipeline to `put-image` with `--image-tag` guarded by a lockfile in S3? two parallel runners could acquire lock.
Alex P: lock would work but is hacky. better to make the tag update a separate step executed by the release leader job.
Maya R: also seeing provenance mismatch alerts in the SBOM check: `provenance: missing-buildstamp` for one of the images. that might be why manifests differ.
Samir: that suggests the build container injected different metadata. I'll open a quick PR to ensure buildstamp is deterministic and baked into image labels.
OpsOnCall: can we avoid re-running both pipelines? that wastes quota. we should cancel the older build and re-run just one.
ci-bot: build 4279 canceled by Maya R.
Alex P: after rollback completes, let's unfreeze and run a single promoted build that will push both the unique tag and then update `release-latest` via a controlled job.
Maya R: adding a short release note: "hotfix: prevent ECR tag race by switching to per-build tags and digest pinning; enforce deterministic buildstamp". keep it in release notes for the next deploy.
Samir: snippet for atomic promotion I used before:\n```
# push unique image
docker build -t $ECR/$REPO:$BUILD_TAG .
docker push $ECR/$REPO:$BUILD_TAG
# then update release-latest with digest
DIGEST=$(aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name $REPO --image-ids imageTag=$BUILD_TAG --query 'images[0].imageId.imageDigest' --output text)
aws ecr put-image --repository-name $REPO --image-tag release-latest --image-manifest "$(aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name $REPO --image-ids imageDigest=$DIGEST --query 'images[0].imageManifest' --output text)"
```
Alex P: nice. let's also add retries to `batch-get-image` and fall back to aborting promotion if manifests mismatch.
Nina: Ops — can you extend the change window by +1h in case the remediation takes longer?
OpsOnCall: added 1h extension to maintenance window.
deploy-bot: Rollback completed. Canary reverted to `release-2026-03-17-3`.
Maya R: follow-up tasks: (1) PR to CI for per-build tags + promotion job (Samir), (2) deterministic buildstamp (Samir), (3) add digest-pinned deploys in K8s manifests (Alex P), (4) update runbook for ECR tag collisions (Nina). I'll add to the release checklist.
Samir: starting the PR now. ETA ~1.5h.
Alex P: thanks everyone. after PR merges we'll re-run a single release pipeline and verify SBOM/provenance before re-enabling `release-latest` promotion. :eyes:
ci-bot: pipeline 4281 queued (single-run promotion) by Alex P.
Nina: thanks — keeping an eye on cost and quotas.
deploy-bot: Thread closed by deploy-bot (auto) after rollback confirmation.
